message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942–1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main Participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army under commanders such as General Georgy Zhukov and Colonel Vasily Chuikov.
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s Sixth Army under General Friedrich Paulus, supported by Luftwaffe air units. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now Volgograd) on the western bank of the **Volga River** in southern Russia. The battle took place within the urban environment of the city and its surrounding industrial area. | The confrontation became one of the deadliest and most pivotal battles of World War II, ultimately turning the tide against Germany on the Eastern Front.
